api.answerHeading: What is the Otero Open API?
api.answer: Otero Open API is a read-only HTTP interface to the AIS Senior Scholars' Basket literature library. Use it to search articles and authors, resolve DOIs or item keys, fetch structured full text when available, export BibTeX or RIS, and query corpus statistics—all via GET requests that never modify the database.
api.intro: Continue from search results to items, structured full text, and citation export; also offers aggregates and timeline stats.
api.ruleWhitelist: Only non-deleted top-level items in the 11 whitelisted journals
api.ruleKey: The key in search results can be used with item, full-text, and export endpoints
api.filterJournals: Multiple journals, comma-separated; mutually exclusive with journal

endpoints.journals: Basket journals on this site (with itemCount; excludes Unfiled)
endpoints.articles: Keyword search for articles; q optional; filter-only browsing allowed
endpoints.exportArticles: Batch-export BibTeX or RIS for article search filters
endpoints.facets: Journal, year, type, and resource-availability aggregates for the current query
endpoints.authors: Keyword search for authors; q required; filters narrow papers and paperCount
endpoints.search: Unified search: articles + authors buckets on one page
endpoints.doiMarkdown: Full-text Markdown by DOI (must be parsed)
endpoints.doiPdf: PDF download URLs by DOI (url / absoluteUrl)
endpoints.item: Full metadata by item key from search results
endpoints.itemMarkdown: Parsed full-text Markdown by item key
endpoints.itemPdf: Relative and absolute PDF URLs by item key
endpoints.itemStructure: Structured full text: outline, figures, equations, references, footnotes
endpoints.itemExport: Export a single item as BibTeX or RIS
endpoints.statsOverview: Basket-wide overview of articles, authors, DOI, PDF, and full-text coverage
endpoints.statsTimeline: Article counts by publication year; supports query and shared filters
endpoints.skill: Agent Skill source (curl / copy to install)

agents.answer: Otero publishes a live SKILL.md so autonomous agents can discover the read-only Open API, search the AIS Basket library, fetch items and full text, and export citations. Copy the skill below or fetch /api/open/v1/SKILL.md directly.
agents.hint: Copy below and save as AGENTS.md or SKILL.md so other agents can access this site's open data.
